description: A new version of a waiting ask: its task's script's (run, token), or the asking Bot's (its own tools, sent a message from the ask's box). Fields left out are the last version's.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

run.description: The asking run's id: a script's.

title.description: What it's called in the Inbox's list (its body's first line, if none).

pictures.description: Its pictures, each by the name its body and buttons use.

form.description: Fields to fill (as a task's form has them): their values go with the button pressed.
